note: Standing rules with a verbatim quote from their source; tests/test_invariants.py fails when a quote drifts.

rules.statement: Draft only; Krish acts. The engine never posts, sends, comments, likes, follows, connects, messages, subscribes or changes a setting on any platform, outside the named exceptions.
rules.quote: Never post, send, comment, like, follow, connect, DM, subscribe, sign up or change a setting on any platform

rules.statement: No email leaves the engine (a saved draft at most) and no money is spent.
rules.quote: Never send an email: at most save a draft. Never spend money.

rules.statement: Saving a draft never authorises scheduling or publication.
rules.quote: Draft saves never authorise scheduling or publication.

rules.statement: Every fact, number and name comes from a published piece or the thread being answered; nothing is invented.
rules.quote: Never invent a number, a quote or a result. If you are unsure, leave it out.

rules.statement: Content-engine owns production and voice standards for every format; Growth applies them (the Canva lane is the 27 Oct exception, R63).
rules.quote: Content-engine owns production and voice standards for every format.

rules.statement: A LinkedIn comment carries no link.
rules.quote: cite their source internally and never invent them. No links in LinkedIn comments.

rules.statement: Nothing in bulk: no mass outreach, automated messages or follow chasing; each ask is for one named person.
rules.quote: No mass outreach, no automated DMs, no follow chasing.

rules.statement: Only real numbers: read today, with where they were read; missing is shown as missing, never guessed or zero.
rules.quote: A number in a report is one you read on a page today, with where you read it.

rules.statement: Work stays in this repository; Control Center, content-engine and every other repository are never changed from here.
rules.quote: Never change Control Center, the content engine or any other repository.

rules.statement: No em dash and no percentage in anything Control Center receives.
rules.quote: Control Center refuses a pack with an em dash or a percentage.

rules.statement: An interactive development session never uses --deliver.
rules.quote: **Never use `--deliver` in an interactive development session.**

rules.statement: Only an approved go-live, read from Control Center in the engine's own run, goes live; a plan, page, tool or session never does.
rules.quote: An interactive session, a page, a tool or an approved plan never authorises any other go-live.

rules.statement: When Krish amends a go-live, his version is what goes out, bound by its recomputed digest.
rules.quote: If he amended it, recompute `amended_sha256` and use his version, never the engine's.

rules.statement: Check in at least twice a week while a plan is open, and after the first results of every go-live.
rules.quote: Check in at least twice a week, and after the first results of every go-live.

rules.statement: Work below the creative bar is held with its reason, never proposed to fill a slot.
rules.quote: Work below the bar is held with its reason, never proposed to fill a slot.

rules.statement: LinkedIn stays unscheduled drafts for Krish's own final click, with no daily quota.
rules.quote: LinkedIn stays unscheduled drafts for Krish's final click, with no daily quota.

rules.statement: A connected personal identity is not in scope until Krish names it.
rules.quote: Other connected personal identities are not automatically in scope.

rules.statement: No parallel production pipeline or quality canon in Growth; superseded for the Canva lane only by R63.
rules.quote: Do not build a parallel production pipeline or quality canon in Growth.

rules.statement: Interactive work makes no Control Center writes.
rules.quote: Interactive work makes no Control Center writes.

rules.statement: Outreach to shows and guests is Control Center's: this engine proposes posts and measures, and holds every pitch, swap and partner note.
rules.quote: So this engine proposes posts and measures. It proposes no pitch, swap or partner note

rules.statement: One ask of each kind waits on Krish's list at a time.
rules.quote: never add a second ask of a kind that already waits.

rules.statement: The 4 Growth Drive folder is link-editable, so private run backups never go there.
rules.quote: The supplied Drive folder is link-editable: never upload private run backups there.

rules.statement: In the weekly audit, creative replacement, re-upload, bio, positioning and pinned-content changes need Krish's approval.
rules.quote: Creative replacement, re-upload, bio, positioning and pinned-content changes require his approval.

rules.statement: Only the Codex in-app browser; no external browser as a fallback.
rules.quote: Do not use Chrome or another external browser as a fallback, even if it has an existing login.

rules.statement: Skyvern is never used, for anything.
rules.quote: Skyvern is excluded from this task: no session listing, connection checks, cloud browser, workflow, profile export or fallback through that provider.

rules.statement: No cookie or credential export, and Stripe is never opened.
rules.quote: Do not export cookies or credentials. Do not open Stripe.

rules.statement: No native desktop apps, OS-wide file dialogs or PC takeover (the one-off Cowork brand kit is the 27 Oct exception, R78).
rules.quote: Do not use native desktop apps, OS-wide file dialogs or PC takeover for this work.

rules.statement: LinkedIn is drafts and recommendations only, during an audit too.
rules.quote: LinkedIn is drafts and recommendations only, including during an audit: no live post/profile edits and no submitted engagement.

rules.statement: A prepared LinkedIn comment is left for Krish; nothing that submits is pressed.
rules.quote: do not press Enter, Comment, Reply, Post or any shortcut that submits.

rules.statement: Buffer draft authority is draft authority, not scheduling or publication authority.
rules.quote: This is draft authority, not scheduling/publication authority.

rules.statement: Document support is never inferred from image uploads, and an uncertain save is never retried without readback.
rules.quote: Never infer document support from image uploads, operate an unowned desktop dialog, or retry an uncertain save without readback.

rules.statement: A signed-out channel stays signed out; note it and read the public page.
rules.quote: If a channel shows you signed out, don't sign in.

rules.statement: Missing edit support means hold; never delete and repost.
rules.quote: Missing edit support means hold; never delete and repost as a workaround.

rules.statement: Without dashboards, say so in the headline and never fill a gap with an estimate.
rules.quote: say in the pack's headline that the dashboards were not available. Never fill a gap with an estimate.

rules.statement: Approved content may get one useful daily post per channel where an approved native edition exists.
rules.quote: Aim for one useful daily post per channel where an approved native edition exists.

rules.statement: Substack articles keep their editorial rhythm, with no daily target.
rules.quote: Substack retains its approved editorial rhythm.

rules.statement: A slot without approved creative stays empty and is recorded; never filled with unapproved work or duplicates.
rules.quote: Record missing supply/capability; never fill a slot with unapproved creative or duplicates.

rules.statement: Scheduled is not published: publication needs the native URL, content, account and a dated readback.
rules.quote: Scheduling proves only a scheduled post. Actual publication needs the native URL/content/account and a dated readback.

rules.statement: Krish's LinkedIn is never queued, scheduled or published by the engine, and no engagement is submitted.
rules.quote: Krish's LinkedIn is unscheduled drafts only. Never queue, schedule, publish, submit comments, like, follow or message.

rules.statement: A Buffer connection never brings a personal identity into scope; Threads entered scope by Krish's 27 Oct ruling (R59), not by its connection.
rules.quote: are not in scope merely because Buffer connects them.

rules.statement: Instagram and Facebook are a verified pair, deduplicated against native cross-sharing.
rules.quote: Verify both outputs independently and deduplicate against native cross-sharing.

rules.statement: Stories never show fake interactive controls or claim poll or link-sticker support.
rules.quote: never draw fake interactive controls or invent poll/link-sticker support.

rules.statement: No illustration-generation boilerplate in public art, captions or descriptions.
rules.quote: Never add illustration-generation boilerplate to public art, captions or descriptions.

rules.statement: Publishing permission brings no spend, new connection, deletion, engagement or paid-offer change.
rules.quote: No spending, new connections, deletion, engagement submission or live paid-offer change follows from this publishing permission.

rules.statement: Offline validation never authenticates approval or acts externally.
rules.quote: Offline validation never authenticates approval or performs an external action.

rules.statement: Reuse the 4 Growth folder; no other Growth root.
rules.quote: Reuse this existing folder. Do not create another Growth root.

rules.statement: No private run or session backup goes into a shared asset folder.
rules.quote: Never upload an entire private run or session backup into a shared asset folder.

rules.statement: No internal metrics, inventories, raw evidence, credentials or journals in the asset library.
rules.quote: Do not put internal metrics, account inventories, raw browser evidence, credentials or operational journals in this library.

rules.statement: Creative approval is not publication or scheduling approval.
rules.quote: Approval of creative does not imply publication or scheduling.

rules.statement: A changed approved file is a new revision needing its own review; release checks the bytes.
rules.quote: If an approved file changes, create a new revision and obtain the required review.

rules.statement: An upload request or a local copy is not a verified cloud archive.
rules.quote: A local copy or successful upload request alone is not proof of a verified cloud archive.

rules.statement: Reusable lessons go in social/lessons, linked from their owner, and social check passes.
rules.quote: Store reusable distribution lessons in `social/lessons/`, link them from their owning channel/format/tool, and run `python growth.py social check`.

rules.statement: A local archive is never described as an off-device backup.
rules.quote: A local archive is not an off-device backup; do not describe it as one.

rules.statement: Krish's personal accounts sound sincere, warm, humble and pleased to share something useful.
rules.quote: Anything posted or prepared under Krish Raja's personal identity must sound sincere, warm, humble and pleased to share something useful.

rules.statement: Classify the owner and byline before choosing a voice.
rules.quote: Identify the actual owner and byline before selecting a voice; connection to Buffer is not permission to add an account to scope.

rules.statement: Warmth is never manufactured from an invented feeling, experience or result.
rules.quote: Never invent a personal feeling, experience, result, relationship or confession to manufacture warmth.

rules.statement: The publication Instagram speaks as makeyourmindup, never as Krish.
rules.quote: Do not impersonate Krish or force a humble first-person introduction onto this publication account.

rules.statement: Copy that fails the voice review is held for revision.
rules.quote: A failed answer holds the copy for revision.

rules.statement: Substack Notes and Threads are in scope (27 Oct), superseding the 14 Oct and 26 Oct lines; Threads is a personal identity (personal voice, R54), and so are Notes, which post from Krish's own profile (R81).
rules.quote: Channels: he chose to add **Substack Notes** and **Threads**.

rules.statement: Krish signs the week: signing is an approved go-live read in the engine's own run (R12); signed exact payloads go out autonomously, anything else waits for his signature; LinkedIn excepted (R62).
rules.quote: Sign the week, but I am likely to want to add in meme style instagram and youtube and tiktok posts randomly too

rules.statement: An ad-hoc idea is built, shown to Krish, and queued only once he approves it.
rules.quote: then the engine will build, show me for approval, and then queue and post autonomously.

rules.statement: LinkedIn stays Krish's own final click under the signed week.
rules.quote: pasting or manual asking". LinkedIn stays his own final click.

rules.statement: The Canva lane (growth-canva) may produce what content-engine does not cover; content-engine keeps its formats and standards (invariants/boundary.json).
rules.quote: For that Canva lane only, this supersedes `docs/ENGINE-BOUNDARY.md`'s no-parallel-production line; content-engine keeps its formats and standards.

rules.statement: Secondary targets come after two weeks of measured baseline; the North Star stays the one number.
rules.quote: proposed after two weeks of measured baseline; the North Star stays the one number.

rules.statement: The What-Works Analyst owns knowing what works.
rules.quote: make someone an owner of that, or build a specialist for it in the engine if there is not already one": the What-Works Analyst owns it.

rules.statement: The 27 Oct rulings authorise no new connection, spend or automation by themselves.
rules.quote: Nothing in these rulings authorises a new connection, spend or automation by itself

rules.statement: Publishing, deploying, creating automations or rotating credentials is never an incidental step of other work.
rules.quote: Never publish, deploy, create automations or rotate credentials as an incidental step.

rules.statement: Say something real: a reply answers the actual thread and never forces in a fact from his piece or a sales angle.
rules.quote: Never force a fact from his piece or a sales angle into a conversation.

rules.statement: A purge on a go-live means stop: nothing goes live, and the closing event is reported with its evidence.
rules.quote: Then report the closing event with its evidence. Purge on a go-live means stop.

rules.statement: At a check-in his yes keeps a plan going, his amendment redirects it and his no stops the plan for good.
rules.quote: his yes keeps it going, his amendment redirects it, his no stops the plan for good.

rules.statement: New creative, new claims and meaning-changing replacements need Krish's approval before they are used.
rules.quote: New creative, claims or meaning-changing replacements require approval.

rules.statement: X and TikTok stay personal identities: delegated cadence never changes their personal voice.
rules.quote: X and TikTok remain personal identities for voice and reputation.

rules.statement: Automatic cross-sharing is never claimed until it has been verified.
rules.quote: Do not claim automatic cross-sharing is enabled unless actually verified.

rules.statement: Before any cleanup, the exact delivery package, its candidates and the feedback are preserved.
rules.quote: Preserve the exact delivery package, candidates and feedback before cleanup.

rules.statement: Production originals are never moved or renamed, and Growth makes no competing production canon.
rules.quote: Never move or rename the production originals or make a competing production canon.

rules.statement: An approved revision is never overwritten and its approval digest is never silently updated.
rules.quote: Do not overwrite the approved revision or silently update its approval digest.

rules.statement: Automations are verified if changed; existing jobs are updated, never duplicated.
rules.quote: Verify automation ownership/schedule if changed. Update existing jobs, never duplicate them.

rules.statement: The one-off brand kit may be built by Cowork computer use on Krish's PC, started by him; nothing else widens.
rules.quote: you can create the brand kit in Canva with computer use on my PC

rules.statement: A signed-in browser may open, scroll, search, sort, filter, open analytics and copy text out; outside the named audit, Buffer draft and LinkedIn preparation exceptions it never types into a post or comment box, presses Post, Publish or Send, or changes a setting.
rules.quote: In a signed-in browser you may open pages, scroll, search, sort and filter, open analytics, and copy text out.

rules.statement: A signed-out state seen in another browser is never taken to mean these accounts are signed out.
rules.quote: Never infer that these accounts are signed out from another browser.

rules.statement: Substack Notes post from Krish's own profile (Buffer channel Krish, handle mindmakerlive), not the publication: his personal voice (R54) and the delegated cadence of X, TikTok and Threads, at most two a day as signed. This supersedes the earlier 27 Oct bullet that Notes post as the publication.
rules.quote: Correction, 27 October 2026 (later the same day). Substack Notes post from a person's profile, not the publication. Krish connected Substack in Buffer as the profile named Krish, the publication owner, whose handle is mindmakerlive (lesson `substack-notes-identity`). Notes therefore keep his personal voice and take the same delegated cadence as X, TikTok and Threads, at up to two a day as signed. The bullet above saying Notes "post as the publication under approved brand content" is superseded by this paragraph.

rules.statement: Renaming the retired mindmakerlive Substack handle is a profile change held for Krish; the engine never makes it.
rules.quote: Renaming the retired mindmakerlive handle is a profile change held for him.

rules.statement: GA4 property G-VC5V9LDE17 on home.makeyourmindup.ai is the Measurement Specialist's per-post attribution source, joined on utm_content; Substack Growth sources remain the North Star source. Krish later ruled that it comes through Control Center (R89); the direct reader in engine/run/ga4.py stays as an unused fallback.
rules.quote: Later the same day: "You have Google Analytics installed already and Control Centre can see that. Make sure this is a part of your Measurement Specialist." GA4 property G-VC5V9LDE17 runs on home.makeyourmindup.ai through Substack's native integration. It is now the Measurement Specialist's per-post attribution source, joined on `utm_content`; Substack Growth sources remain the North Star source. He then offered: "Happy to let you read Google Analytics directly if you prefer." The engine reads GA4 directly with a read-only service account (Viewer on that one property); the Control Center brief (`docs/briefs/2026-10-27-control-center-ga4-read.md`) is kept as the fallback.

rules.statement: Every session, interactive or scheduled, preserves its learning and assets in their structured places.
rules.quote: Ruling: Krish, 27 October 2026. Preserve session learning and assets in structured places every session. This applies to interactive work and scheduled jobs.

rules.statement: Every campaign stores a manifest with SHA-256, byte size, revision, source identity and approval scope.
rules.quote: Store a manifest with SHA-256, byte size, revision, source identity and approval scope.

rules.statement: Candidates, rejections and production prompts stay in their owning private or Content Engine archive, never beside approved files without an explicit historical or rejected label.
rules.quote: Keep candidates/rejections and production prompts in their owning private or Content Engine archive. They must never appear beside approved files without an explicit historical/rejected label.

rules.statement: A Drive write inspects existing children first, prevents duplicates, uploads to the verified parent and reads back names, parents and sizes independently.
rules.quote: Use Drive tools to inspect existing children before writes, prevent duplicates, upload to the verified parent, and independently read back names, parents and sizes (checksums when exposed).

rules.statement: Access is rechecked before sensitive material is uploaded; a folder named Private is never treated as an access boundary.
rules.quote: Recheck access before uploading sensitive material; do not treat a folder named Private as an access boundary.

rules.statement: GA4 readings reach this engine through Control Center (its daily mymu snapshot and the web_analytics directive block, protocol 1.10.0), not a direct GA credential.
rules.quote: Google Analytics: "just get google analytics from control center, might be easier." Control Center already reads GA4 property mymu (G-VC5V9LDE17) daily but does not pass it to engines or break it down by `utm_content`.

rules.statement: The 21 Oct existing-field audit authority covers the Facebook Page and Threads; LinkedIn stays Krish's alone; protected fields still need his approval.
rules.quote: Audit authority: "yes extend". The 2026-10-21 existing-field audit authority (titles, captions, descriptions, links, broken profile links, subscription-link alignment) now also covers the Facebook Page and Threads.

rules.statement: For the GA4 change only, Krish lifted rule 7 so this session applies it in krishanraja/control-center; every other Control Center rule holds.
rules.quote: "apply the Control Center change yourself". For this one change only, rule 7 (stay in this repository) is lifted

rules.statement: Public copy carries no eyebrow labels, asterisks, AI-provenance notes or take labels: content-engine's copy lint, vendored unchanged, refuses them in run lint, preflight, release, autonomous audit repairs of live titles, captions and descriptions, and drafted pack replies.
rules.quote: don't add stupid eyebrow text and asterisks and "generated by AI" and "Krish's take" verbal diahorrea like you tend to. This needs to feel like a world class media channel

rules.statement: Release acts only on this engine's eight Buffer channels, pinned by service, name and channelId, and refuses the other ventures' channels by id in every release step. On the draft path, social preflight refuses a Buffer package that names any channelId but its pinned one and, given the get_post readback of a reused draft with --target, refuses an edit_post target on any other channel, not a draft or imported from the network. That a session runs preflight with --target before each edit_post is process (social/guides/buffer.md); the code cannot see the call.
rules.quote: Release acts only on a channel whose service, name and channelId all match its pinned entry, and refuses the fulltime.fm TikTok, the Heartside Facebook Page and both yourdoghasnotes channels by id, wherever they appear

rules.statement: Go-live is approved per day on the Monday final board; it authorises scheduling exactly that day's approved payloads, read back from Buffer. Pulling a post until its slot is Wave 2 (plan W5) and is not built or claimed here.
rules.quote: Approving a day on the Monday final board authorises scheduling exactly that day's posts, nothing more.

rules.statement: Every route goes through Buffer, and each route's first real post is a capability check he approves: on a route not yet verified and fresh, release schedules only one capability check and holds the rest until the route is recorded as passed. The check is the one this run's ledger already released, else the run's earliest approved post; a check released in any other run's ledger and not yet recorded as passed holds the route in this run too. Release posts no article; the saved-draft fallback for an article is Wave 2.
rules.quote: Each route's first real post is a capability check he approves on that Monday; until a route has passed it, the route holds.

rules.statement: Growth makes derived carousels to content-engine's standard, floor and copy lint, applied by reference; this supersedes the 26 Oct production split for carousels only.
rules.quote: Growth makes derived carousels to content-engine's standard. This supersedes the 26 October production split for carousels only

rules.statement: Growth owns the Tuesday, Thursday, Saturday and Sunday lane on Instagram, TikTok and YouTube Shorts; each post is approved with one press and goes in the next free off-day slot, never on Monday, Wednesday or Friday or over a daily cap.
rules.quote: Growth puts the post in the next free off-day slot on each chosen channel, never on Monday, Wednesday or Friday and never over a daily cap, and reads it back.

rules.statement: Engagement is a daily 10-minute queue across X, TikTok, Instagram and LinkedIn with one-click copy and exact links; it stays prepared only and he submits every reply.
rules.quote: The daily queue is drafted here and he submits every reply himself; following and liking stay his.

rules.statement: Every snackable package and run slot is built to be sent: it declares a specific sender and receiver, one share job, the exact DM line, the moment and a standalone check; generic share calls to action are refused in snackable post copy (in run lint, social preflight and again at release); a blind reader, bound to the exact revision by its request_sha256, must name the declared receiver and job before Krish sees it, and run status compares that answer again with the slot's share block on every read.
rules.quote: I am not talking about just saying "share this with your friends" in the comments, I am talking about ensuring all the produced snackable content is likelier to be shared for a specific reason.

rules.statement: No public word names Krish: content-engine's copy lint no_name pattern, vendored unchanged, refuses his name, its spellings and handles in run lint, preflight captions and alt text, release words, carried alt text and titles, autonomous audit repairs, drafted pack replies and the post drafts the Control Center loop proposes. No override, another Krish included; first person stays on his personal accounts.
rules.quote: Remember, no content refers to Krish, ever. I still see that popping up from time to time. Even articles written are not authored by Krish. My face only, for assets and the video format.

rules.statement: On Instagram, YouTube, TikTok and X, Krish's approval of a concept (its idea, one claim and mock files, bound by concept_sha256 and listed in the week's mix plan proposal) authorises release of every post made from it with no per-post digest, through the same release gate and Buffer channel lock, only while the post is one of the concept's placements, carries only its mock files and carries its claim word for word; a post that departs is a lint error and is held at release, every other check still runs, his stop on a concept or on the mix plan holds every post from it, and LinkedIn stays his click.
rules.quote: I just need to be in control of the idea and the mocks and then I'm happy to let you let that engine just go for gold.

rules.statement: Instagram, YouTube, TikTok and X take up to four scheduled posts a day with a floor of three the weekly mix plans; their channel records, the social policy bound, run lint's daily cap and the urgency caps agree, no urgency caps them below three, and every other channel keeps its own bound.
rules.quote: When it comes to Instagram, YouTube, and TikTok, I am more than happy to pump out three or four posts a day on all three of those platforms. Same with X and Twitter.

rules.statement: The weekly mix planner turns every past piece in the backlog inventory into carousel concepts, oldest unamplified first, and interleaves them with memes, positive news (a primary source dated within 7 days) and level-up advice at mix.json's weights, deterministically, with no piece or idea twice on one channel in a week and no empty slot filled; its concepts go to Krish as one plan proposal behind strategy listing every concept hash, the Sunday report carries it, and each post's What-Works verdict joined to its concept and lane moves a lane one step inside its bounds next week.
rules.quote: For Make Your Mind Up I think the engine needs to strategize how to repurpose all the previous posts into carousels and intertwine them with the memes, positive news pieces, and the other filler pieces that we decided on.
